title: Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency: Rate Schedule for an Additional Deposit
content:
**Finance office note, deposits — Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency.** The deposit schedule of the additional deposit follows the agreement's rate notice. A notice takes effect for the agreement on the later of 1 July 2026, the current schedule's effective date, and the delivery date plus 60 days.

| Agreement's rate notice | Deposit schedule |
|---|---|
| Delivery date recorded, notice taken effect on or before the day the deposit is worked out | The current private pay schedule |
| Delivery date recorded, notice not yet taken effect | The preceding schedule |
| No delivery date recorded | The schedule in effect on the admission date: current for an admission on or after 1 July 2026, preceding otherwise |

| Accommodation tier | Preceding schedule (effective 1 July 2025), USD per day | Current schedule (effective 1 July 2026), USD per day |
|---|---|---|
| Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room | 384.00 | 398.00 |
| Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room | 412.00 | 427.00 |
| Private Long-Term Care Room | 421.00 | 436.00 |
| Private Secure Memory Care Room | 449.00 | 465.00 |
| Private Bariatric Care Room | 466.00 | 482.00 |
| Private Suite with Sitting Area | 497.00 | 514.00 |

**Boundary (hypothetical).** A notice delivered 60 days before the day the deposit is worked out, that day falling after 1 July 2026: taken effect, current schedule. Delivered 59 days before: not yet, preceding schedule.
